title: Design System: Monolith v02 — Everyday Orbit

expressive.purpose: Selected phrases, italic style, inheriting the surrounding size.

motion.name: rebalance-duration
motion.purpose: Transform-only transitions between three authored arrangements; immediate under reduced motion.

motion.name: rebalance-easing
motion.purpose: Settle from the sampled in-flight frame toward the latest target.

components.name: Rebalance
components.description: One native button on the cobalt balance study; its page behavior cycles authored arrangements.
components.css: .ds-rebalance { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.75rem; font:600 1rem 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; background:var(--citrus,#D4DA67); color:var(--ink,#192329); border:1px solid var(--citrus,#D4DA67); border-radius:2rem; padding:.9rem 1.4rem; cursor:pointer; } .ds-rebalance svg { width:1.25em; height:1.25em; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.5; } .ds-rebalance:hover { background:var(--chalk,#F4F1E7); border-color:var(--chalk,#F4F1E7); } .ds-rebalance:active { border-color:var(--ink,#192329); } .ds-rebalance:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--chalk,#F4F1E7); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Native return navigation
components.description: Underlined native navigation within the version; target points back to the hub.
components.html: All concepts
components.css: .ds-return { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.6rem; padding-block:.6rem; color:var(--ink,#192329); font:.875rem 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.25em; text-decoration-thickness:1px; } .ds-return svg { width:1.25em; height:1.25em; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.5; } .ds-return:hover { text-decoration-thickness:2px; } .ds-return:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--cobalt,#2446DB); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Asset download row
components.description: Native download row with an inset name, format, and outlined arrow.
components.html: Primary symbolSVG
components.css: .ds-download { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:1rem; padding-block:1.5rem; border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink,#192329) 25%,transparent); font:1rem 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; color:var(--ink,#192329); text-decoration:none; } .ds-download span:last-child { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.75rem; color:var(--cobalt,#2446DB); font-size:.875rem; } .ds-download svg { width:1.25em; height:1.25em; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.5; } .ds-download:hover span:first-child { text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.25em; } .ds-download:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--cobalt,#2446DB); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Coral swatch
components.description: Decorative coral field with both labels on a readable chalk strip.
components.css: .ds-coral-swatch { display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:end; min-height:12rem; background:var(--coral,#D75565); font:1rem 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-coral-swatch span { padding:.5rem 1.25rem; background:var(--chalk,#F4F1E7); color:var(--ink,#192329); } .ds-coral-swatch span:last-child { font-size:.875rem; padding-top:0; padding-bottom:1rem; }

narrative.overview: A welcoming working world held together by a useful center. Physical mobile structures connect different shapes without forcing them to become identical. This system is an independent proposal scoped to v02; it is not Monolith’s adopted identity and does not govern the hub or v01.

rules.name: The Readable Ground Rule
rules.body: Use ink on chalk (14.14:1) or citrus (10.67:1), or chalk on cobalt (6.25:1) or ink (14.14:1). Ink on coral is 4.09:1, below the ordinary-text threshold. Coral’s swatch label is on chalk; Knowledge is labeled in chalk outside its coral form.

rules.name: The Expressive Phrase Rule
rules.body: Italic phrases inherit the surrounding size and use Newsreader at weight 400. Headings are balanced and can break long words when text is enlarged; type specimens also allow word wrapping. Body measure is capped at 65ch, with shorter measures beside artwork. Root text size follows browser preferences.

dos: Do keep different weights visibly connected through a light structure.
Do use the tested text/ground combinations and visible keyboard focus.
Do preserve native links, downloads, scrolling, reduced motion, and the complete default arrangement.
Do label illustrative applications and describe OpenJM assistance as a proposed purpose.
donts: Don't put ordinary text on coral or make the symbol depend on a font.
Don't turn this version’s identity into a permanent product decision or a template for other versions.
